title: The Andersons to Present at Stephens Annual Investment Conference

body_markdown:
MAUMEE, Ohio


, Nov. 11, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- The Andersons, Inc. (Nasdaq: ANDE) announces that it will present at the Stephens Annual Investment Conference on Wednesday, November 18, 2026.


President and Chief Executive Officer Bill Krueger and Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Brian Valentine will speak at the conference at 1:15 p.m. Central Time. The Andersons presentation will be broadcast live[here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820514-1&h=897134244&u=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.summitcast.com%2Fview%2FAnJcL7fjsXraGqV8XG6fRL%2FSyUxrCtL6p9ABeRNduw4zv&a=here) . A recording will also be available for a short time at the same location.


"From our record third-quarter earnings to the recent announcement to acquire[Harvestone Low Carbon Partners](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820514-1&h=3072375375&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.andersonsinc.com%2F2026-11-04-The-Andersons%2C-Inc-to-Acquire-Harvestone-Low-Carbon-Partners%2C-Expanding-Ethanol-Production-Capacity-and-Low-Carbon-Fuels-Capabilities&a=Harvestone+Low+Carbon+Partners) , we continue to make strong progress toward achieving the goals we outlined at our December 2025 Investor Day and look forward to sharing how we are driving long-term growth and value for our shareholders," said President and CEO Bill Krueger.


For more information on The Andersons' announced acquisition of Harvestone Low Carbon Partners, click[here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820514-1&h=3860926625&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.andersonsinc.com%2Fimage%2FHarvestone_Low_Carbon_Partners.pdf&a=here) .


**About The Andersons, Inc.** The Andersons, Inc., is a diversified company rooted in agriculture that conducts business in the agribusiness and renewables sectors. Guided by its Statement of Principles, The Andersons is committed to providing extraordinary service to its customers, helping its employees improve, supporting its communities, and increasing the value of the company. For more information, please visit[www.andersonsinc.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820514-1&h=3737631885&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.andersonsinc.com%2F&a=www.andersonsinc.com) .
